newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Cook to hold talks with Albright.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Cook to hold talks with Albright.

text.p: New British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook will visit Washington on May 18 to 19 for his first face-to-face talks with U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, the Foreign Office said on Thursday.
A ministry statement said Cook -- who came to power after Labour's massive May 1 election win -- would also meet Defence Secretary William Cohen and other senior officials.
Albright called Cook immediately after Labour's win was confirmed to say she was confident the two countries would enjoy close relations.

Ties between Washington and the outgoing Conservative government never really recovered after former prime minister John Major supported then-President George Bush in the 1992 election which Bill Clinton won.
